versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-seo-magic-button: the one-command solution for AI-SEO audits and planning.
- Automatically generates a full-site AEO/GEO audit and delivers an actionable improvement plan (plan.json and markdown checklist).
- Responds to user triggers such as "audit my site for AI SEO" and "generate an AI-SEO plan".
- Provides a two-step workflow: audit/plan generation followed by prioritized execution.
- Integrates seamlessly with ai-seo and citation-intelligence engines for comprehensive analysis.
